$comment: Every shot Syl has ever been rendered in, with the exact prompt that made it.
This file exists because the first eight loops were generated on 2026-08-10 and
THE PROMPTS WERE NEVER WRITTEN DOWN. Eight finished videos, some of them very
good, and no way to make a ninth in the same style or to fix the two that
failed — the outputs survived and the inputs did not.
So: a shot is not the mp4. A shot is the prompt, the reference, the model and
the duration. The mp4 is what those produce, and it can always be produced
again. Add a shot here, then run:
`framing` is one of the four ids in backend/src/render/framing.ts, not free
text. It goes into the sidecar, and the service reads a sidecar with an
unrecognised framing as UNREADABLE rather than guessing — which is right:
the framing is what says whether the reference could hold her likeness at
all. What each one means, and the render that proved it, is in that file.
The prompts below for shots 1-8 are RECONSTRUCTED from the outputs and the
filenames, not recovered — the originals are gone. They are marked so, and
regenerating from them will produce something in the same spirit rather than
the same clip. Everything added after this file exists is exact.

shots.name: 1-emerge
shots.prompt: A luminous spirit woman of living starlight drifts into view against a deep blue starfield, seen from behind and three-quarters, her face turned away toward the stars. Long silver-white hair and a translucent flowing gown trail like ribbons of light. She turns slowly, weightless, as motes of light spiral around her. Opens on a lone ribbon of blue light against empty starfield, with no figure present. The ribbon gathers and coalesces into her, her whole body made of that same living light. At the end she unravels back into the ribbon and it streams away, leaving empty starfield. The first and last frames are identical: the bare ribbon, no figure.
